headline: Philippine Central Bank Short-Term Bills Average Yield Rises for Seventh Week
summary: Yields on Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas short-term bills increased for a seventh consecutive week during auction offerings.
why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas issues short-term securities to manage banking system liquidity and steer interest rates.

impacts.name: Philippine BSP Bill Yield
impacts.why: Short-term central bank bill rates rose for seven straight weeks on subdued auction demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weak market demand at auction drove yields on central bank short-term bills higher for a seventh week.
